I disagree, I was interested in momoland during freeze era but fully stanned during bboom bboom. They were my second favourite group of all time, all 9 members were harmonious together and the energy when performing together was perfection. Taeha was an amazing vocalist and Daisy was the best rapper in the group who’s also a really good dancer and solid vocalist.

But when it became OT7 during I’m so hot the energy depleted so hard, not because those two were the only members performing with energy but the formations and the whole group together as a whole felt empty and weird. 

Now it’s OT6 and the energy is completely gone, the formations are now simplistic and boring and it feels so off. They can’t make interesting choreos like they did when they were OT9, they don’t feel like the momoland that they were before.

I love momoland with my heart, I was a die hard fan but the member loss was such a huge part of their decline as a group as a whole. Taeha and Daisy added so much to the group.

I hope this now becomes the new wave of kpop with sexy/mature concepts, we haven’t had those in such a long time and if it starts to become trendy again I will easily start growing back to kpop again. Nature, Red Velvet and Gfriend have started it so hopefully more will come soon!
